seriesTitle: The Boss Baby: Back in the Crib

episodes.title: The Business Boss: Back in Baby
episodes.summary: The Boss Baby returns to the office to find a culture greatly changed. But to get his old job back, he'll have to steal it from his talented niece, Tina.

episodes.title: The Stroll
episodes.summary: Tina and the Boss Baby struggle to co-lead on their first joint field mission: freeing the baby with the world's best hair from an epic lice outbreak.

episodes.title: Potty Mouth
episodes.summary: After a cute baby says a no-no word on live TV, the Boss Baby becomes obsessed with pinning the blame on a new archnemesis: Lumpy the Park Duck.

episodes.title: Imaginary Friends
episodes.summary: Baby culture is crawling with imaginary friends these days, but the Boss Baby isn't playing along. Enter HR with some sensitivity training.

episodes.title: Turf War
episodes.summary: When Tina tries to calm a toddler turf war by befriending a notorious baby bully, she goes too far — and the field team's forced to rein her in.

episodes.title: Trading Up
episodes.summary: HR makes the Boss Baby take a day off, so he decides to give Tabitha business lessons. Elsewhere, the Uncuddleables are working harder than ever.

episodes.title: War of the Cheeks
episodes.summary: Boss Baby's quest to crush the Uncuddleables gets sidetracked by a Templeton tradition: a Go Fish tournament where the winner rules the family for a day.

episodes.title: Techy Tykes
episodes.summary: Boss Baby and Tina invite Tabitha to the office — and Tim tags along. But the special guests are the top suspects when the all-powerful UBO goes missing.

episodes.title: Birthday Blues
episodes.summary: It's the Boss Baby's birthday, and he's celebrating like an adult! There's just one problem: He still needs Carol to push his stroller around Chicago.

episodes.title: Sitting Ducks
episodes.summary: The team willingly places themselves in the care of the Uncuddleables with plans to expose them... until Tina falls hard for her tricky babysitter.

episodes.title: The Big Dumpling
episodes.summary: In a bid to sabotage the Lil' Dumpling Pageant, the Uncuddleables replace all of Baby Corp's super-cute top performers with the not-so-cute bottom 5%.

episodes.title: The Great Medieval London Fire of 1135
episodes.summary: A surprising partnership could turn Baby Corp's entire business model upside-down — and change the way the world looks at baby love. Time to re-org!

episodes.title: Untitled Templeton Project
episodes.summary: With no name, zero capital and countless rivals, the Templetons' scrappy startup takes on risky new client Cathy — the most-hated baby in town.

episodes.title: Puppy Love
episodes.summary: The team explores a promising side hustle: reforming naughty puppies. But their pack of potential new clients leads them to a hair-raising discovery.

episodes.title: Biscuits Rising
episodes.summary: A scheming British schoolboy baby who was secretly hired to ruin Teddy and Tina's lives lures the team into a trap that's crawling with mind games.

episodes.title: Moonshot
episodes.summary: The team competes with their Baby Corp rivals in a cutthroat "space race" to see who can create the cutest — and kid-friendliest — fake moon landing.

episodes.title: Inner Children
episodes.summary: JJ's on the job when the town's adults accidentally sample special formula that gives them all "baby brains." Can she fix it before Tina finds out?

episodes.title: Poompf!
episodes.summary: Crispin Biscuits cooks up a plan to frame the Untitled Templeton Project for a plush toy explosion. But Tina's going all in to clear the company name.

episodes.title: The Heat Is On
episodes.summary: It's hot — and babies are cranky. Can the Templetons find a way around the country club splash pad's strict "no babies" rule before the team melts down?

episodes.title: One Tricked Pony
episodes.summary: Crispin Biscuits pulls a beastly power move: luring Precious the pony away from the Templetons. Now it's up to the team to convince her he's bad news.

episodes.title: Federal Slumber Party
episodes.summary: Uncle Benji's in town with two big surprises: a cute baby of his own and ambitions to become a federal agent, putting Boss Baby's real identity at risk.

episodes.title: Floaties
episodes.summary: Tina's relaxing stay at a baby resort goes off the rails when Crispin Biscuits has everyone convinced that she's not actually Tina... but someone else.

episodes.title: Breaking the Bank
episodes.summary: For his next trick, Crispin Biscuits plots to rob the underwater Baby Bank — but not if Boss Baby, Tina and Banker Baby Benny can sink his plans.

episodes.title: Hate That Baby!
episodes.summary: After Crispin Biscuits alters the economy to reward Baby Hate, the Boss Baby's forced to become the town's least lovable baby to save the startup.

episodes.title: North of the Border
episodes.summary: With Teddy hiding out in Canada, Tina tries to hold the company together. But Baby Love's tanking, thanks to adult baddies who've shrunk to baby size.

episodes.title: Intensive Purposes
episodes.summary: Dez and Aubrey go undercover to expose Russ Tisdale as a criminal kingpin. Elsewhere, Boss Baby and crew try to brainstorm their way out of captivity.

episodes.title: The Unshakeable Bear
episodes.summary: The team searches for the elusive Dr. The Beard with the feds — and a bear — in hot pursuit. Tabitha pulls an inside job. Tina takes a critical test.

episodes.title: Ba-Ba Town
episodes.summary: Peek-a-boo! Familiar faces return to help the Templetons take down the Shrinkies and get the Boss Baby his old life back. But will their plan work?
